<script>
(function(){
  var EVENTS = {"2026":1056101,"2025":904960,"2023":681853};
  var API = "https://runsignup.com/rest/race/83604/results/get-results";
  var RACE_DAY = new Date("2026-09-20T00:00:00-06:00");
  var DOT = " \u00B7 ";
  var DASH = " \u2014 ";
  var APOS = "\u2019";
  function byId(i){ return document.getElementById(i); }
  function fetchPage(y, per, pg){
    var u = API + "?event_id=" + EVENTS[y] + "&format=json&results_per_page=" + per + "&page=" + pg;
    return fetch(u, {cache:"no-store"}).then(function(r){ return r.json(); });
  }
  function rowsOf(d){ var s = (d && d.individual_results_sets) || []; return s.length ? (s[0].results || []) : []; }
  function finishOf(r){ return r.chip_time || r.clock_time || "\u2014"; }
  function nameOf(r){ return ((r.first_name || "") + " " + (r.last_name || "")).trim(); }
  function el(tag, cls, txt){
    var e = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) e.className = cls;
    if (txt != null) e.textContent = txt;
    return e;
  }
  var yearSel = byId("sflb-year"), topnSel = byId("sflb-topn"), tbody = byId("sflb-rows");
  if (!yearSel) return;
  var raceDay = new Date() >= RACE_DAY;
  Object.keys(EVENTS).sort(function(a,b){ return b - a; }).forEach(function(y){
    var o = el("option", null, y);
    o.value = y;
    if ((raceDay && y === "2026") || (!raceDay && y === "2025")) o.selected = true;
    yearSel.appendChild(o);
  });
  function statusRow(msg){
    tbody.textContent = "";
    var tr = el("tr"), td = el("td", "status", msg);
    td.colSpan = 4;
    tr.appendChild(td);
    tbody.appendChild(tr);
  }
  function load(){
    fetchPage(yearSel.value, topnSel.value, 1).then(function(data){
      var rows = rowsOf(data);
      if (!rows.length){
        statusRow("Results haven" + APOS + "t posted yet for " + yearSel.value + DASH + "check back on race day.");
      } else {
        tbody.textContent = "";
        rows.forEach(function(r){
          var tr = el("tr");
          tr.appendChild(el("td", "place", r.place));
          var td = el("td");
          td.appendChild(el("span", "name", nameOf(r)));
          var meta = "bib #" + r.bib;
          if (r.gender) meta += DOT + r.gender;
          if (r.age) meta += DOT + r.age;
          td.appendChild(el("div", "meta", meta));
          tr.appendChild(td);
          tr.appendChild(el("td", "time", finishOf(r)));
          tr.appendChild(el("td", "pace", r.pace ? r.pace + "/mi" : ""));
          tbody.appendChild(tr);
        });
      }
      byId("sflb-stamp").textContent = "updated " + new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
    }).catch(function(){
      statusRow("Couldn" + APOS + "t reach the results feed" + DASH + "full results at runsignup.com/Race/Results/83604");
    });
  }
  function findMe(){
    var bib = byId("sflb-bib").value.trim(), out = byId("sflb-findout");
    if (!bib){ out.textContent = "Enter a bib number."; return; }
    out.textContent = "Looking\u2026";
    var page = 1;
    function step(){
      fetchPage(yearSel.value, 1000, page).then(function(data){
        var rows = rowsOf(data);
        for (var i = 0; rows.length > i; i++){
          if (String(rows[i].bib) === bib){
            var r = rows[i];
            out.textContent = nameOf(r) + ": " + finishOf(r) + DOT + "place " + r.place + (r.pace ? DOT + r.pace + "/mi" : "");
            return;
          }
        }
        if (rows.length === 1000 && 50 > page){ page++; step(); }
        else { out.textContent = "No " + yearSel.value + " result for bib #" + bib + "."; }
      }).catch(function(){ out.textContent = "Couldn" + APOS + "t reach the results feed."; });
    }
    step();
  }
  byId("sflb-refresh").addEventListener("click", load);
  yearSel.addEventListener("change", load);
  topnSel.addEventListener("change", load);
  byId("sflb-findbtn").addEventListener("click", findMe);
  byId("sflb-bib").addEventListener("keydown", function(e){ if (e.key === "Enter") findMe(); });
  load();
  if (raceDay) setInterval(load, 30000);
})();
</script>

      <details class="faq-item"><summary>Is the course really at altitude?</summary><div class="faq-answer">Yes — the course runs between 6,567 and 6,883 ft, climbing 651 ft to the turnaround at mile 9 before heading home. Arrive a day or two early to acclimate, and hydrate more than usual.</div></details>
      <details class="faq-item"><summary>Where do I pick up my packet?</summary><div class="faq-answer">At the Health & Wellness Expo at Warehouse 21 in the Railyard — Friday 12:00–6:00 PM or Saturday 10:00 AM–5:00 PM. There is also race-morning pickup at Romero’s Park, 6:00–7:00 AM, open to everyone — but the roads into the start close at 7:00, so pick up at the expo if you can.</div></details>
      <details class="faq-item"><summary>How does the 3-Amigos Relay work?</summary><div class="faq-answer">Three runners split the 13.1 between them, passing a ceremonial sash at two staffed exchange zones. One sash per team, worn across the chest by the active runner.</div></details>
      <details class="faq-item"><summary>Is there a time limit?</summary><div class="faq-answer">The course stays open for 4 hours 30 minutes (about a 20:30/mile pace), closing at 12:00 PM. Walkers are welcome, and a sweep vehicle follows the final runner.</div></details>
      <details class="faq-item"><summary>Can I get a refund?</summary><div class="faq-answer">Entries are non-refundable, but you may defer to the following year or transfer your bib to another runner through September 10, 2026.</div></details>

<script>
(function(){
  var mq = window.matchMedia("(max-width:700px)");
  var cols = document.querySelectorAll(".sfhm .foot-col");
  // A heading is not a button. Put a real one inside it, so the control is
  // announced as a button, carries its expanded state, and gets Enter/Space
  // handling from the platform rather than a hand-rolled keydown listener.
  // The button only exists at the width where the accordion is live, so desktop
  // keyboard users do not collect dead tab stops.
  var recs = [];
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(cols, function(col, i){
    var head = col.querySelector("h3");
    var panel = col.querySelector("ul");
    if (!head || !panel) return;
    if (!panel.id) panel.id = "foot-col-panel-" + i;
    recs.push({ col: col, head: head, panel: panel, btn: null });
  });
  function build(c){
    if (c.btn) return;
    var btn = document.createElement("button");
    btn.type = "button";
    btn.className = "foot-col__btn";
    btn.setAttribute("aria-controls", c.panel.id);
    btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(c.col.classList.contains("open")));
    // The language toggle writes textContent into every [data-es] element, which
    // would delete a button nested inside one. Carry the pair on the button.
    var en = c.head.getAttribute("data-en"), es = c.head.getAttribute("data-es");
    if (en !== null) { btn.setAttribute("data-en", en); c.head.removeAttribute("data-en"); }
    if (es !== null) { btn.setAttribute("data-es", es); c.head.removeAttribute("data-es"); }
    while (c.head.firstChild) btn.appendChild(c.head.firstChild);
    c.head.appendChild(btn);
    btn.addEventListener("click", function(){
      var open = !c.col.classList.contains("open");
      c.col.classList.toggle("open", open);
      btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
    });
    c.btn = btn;
  }
  function teardown(c){
    if (!c.btn) return;
    var en = c.btn.getAttribute("data-en"), es = c.btn.getAttribute("data-es");
    if (en !== null) c.head.setAttribute("data-en", en);
    if (es !== null) c.head.setAttribute("data-es", es);
    while (c.btn.firstChild) c.head.insertBefore(c.btn.firstChild, c.btn);
    c.head.removeChild(c.btn);
    c.btn = null;
    c.col.classList.remove("open");
  }
  function sync(){
    for (var i = 0; i !== recs.length; i++) { if (mq.matches) build(recs[i]); else teardown(recs[i]); }
  }
  sync();
  if (mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener("change", sync);
  else if (mq.addListener) mq.addListener(sync);
})();
</script>
